 Frost Advisory is in effect FWPD: Units investigating a shooting in north of downtown Fort Wayne 
 Two in custody after stabbing (WPTA) By WPTA Staff Published : Oct. 17, 2026 at 5:55 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WPTA) - Police and medics are responding to reports of a shooting called out on Saturday, north of downtown Fort Wayne.
 Units were dispatched to the 2300 block of Spy Run Ave. at around 5:20 p.m.
 This is a developing story, and injuries are unknown. The shooting is under investigation by FWPD.
